text.p: Following are the main stories in Wednesday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said contractors undertaking public projects, especially schools, must complete work on time. He was expressing his annoyance at the delay of completion of a school in north-east Terengganu state.
-- Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto arrives in Kuala Lumpur today for an official visit.
-- The government has received a proposal by Sapura Holdings Sdn Bhd to buy an equity stake in vehicle concern UMW Holdings Bhd, said Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim.

-- Mahathir said the win by opposition Islamic party PAS in a by-election in north-east Kelantan state showed Kelantanese preferred PAS even if it was at the expense of development and smooth government administration.
-- Olympia Industries said its gaming licence in eastern Sabah state has been renewed by the Ministry of Finance.
